name: Botswana Metalheads
summary: The local scene, sometimes referred to as Hellbangers or Metal Cowboys , grew organically as an authentic DIY subculture largely uncorrupted by outside commercial influence.
description: The local scene, sometimes referred to as Hellbangers or Metal Cowboys , grew organically as an authentic DIY subculture largely uncorrupted by outside commercial influence. The music serves as a rebellious movement against authority and a means to express social conditions and emotional honesty.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Warrior spirit, authenticity, community, defiance, social justice, reclaiming the blues influence on metal music

visualDNA.colour: Black, silver (studs), muted earth tones, leather/cattlehide
